summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that kept `python3 main.py` from running. In `main.py` I changed the import from the nonexistent `greetings` module to `greeter`, and in `greeter.py` I added the missing colon after `def greet(name)`. The program now runs cleanly and prints `Hello, world!`.
